name: Accurate Attacks
text: The living liquid is precise and accurate, giving it a bonus on all accuracy rolls.

name: Aetherial Glow
text: The living liquid absorbs aether and glows, creating a bright light that can easily be seen for some distance. It also perfectly lights up a rather large area. The liquid can dim this light or turn it off at any time for no cost.

name: Cannibalizing Ooze
text:
Cost: 1 AP
The living liquid can absorb other adjacent living liquids in order to regain hit points. When it absorbs an adjacent living liquid, the target liquid instantly evaporates and the living liquid gains a number of hit points back (up to its maximum). It can only cannibalize living liquids that allow it to happen.

name: Defensive
text:
Requires: Interior Platelets augment (book typo: "Interior Platements")
The living liquid knows how to take a blow and keep sliming on. It gains a bonus on defense rolls.

name: Drenching
marques: Anyone hit by this living liquid is splashed and considered wet (takes more damage from electric attacks).
notes: always priced mQ I (5 princes to buy, 1 prince to craft)
text:
The living liquid appears to be made primarily out of water. Anyone who is hit by this living liquid is splashed by water and is considered wet. (Be careful - once an opponent is wet, they take more damage from electric attacks!)
Note: When determining cost, this augment functions as a Marque I augment. Thus, it costs 5 princes to buy or 1 prince to craft.

name: Electric Current
marques: deals 1 electric damage; unsoakable if target is in metal armor or wet
deals 2 electric damage; unsoakable if target is in metal armor or wet
deals 3 electric damage; unsoakable if target is in metal armor or wet
deals 4 electric damage; unsoakable if target is in metal armor or wet
text:
Cost: 2 AP
The living liquid has a powerful electric current running through it that shocks anything the liquid touches. When struck with a metallic object, the wielder of the object suffers the electrical damage.

name: Explosion Eater
text:
Cost: 1 AP
The living liquid is able to absorb an adjacent explosive and, when it goes off, hold in some of the blast. The explosive must be adjacent to the living liquid and it costs 1 action point for the living liquid to absorb it. The living liquid will take damage from the explosion normally, but it lessens the amount of damage dealt to everyone else within the explosion's range.

name: Flaming Burst
marques: adjacent enemies catch on tier 1 fire
adjacent enemies catch on tier 1 fire
adjacent enemies catch on tier 2 fire
adjacent enemies catch on tier 2 fire
notes: Cost: 2 AP (the liquid's); once per liquid's life
text:
Cost: 2 AP
The living liquid has petrol running through it. Once during the liquid's life, it can burst into flames, lighting any adjacent people on fire. The living liquid is immune to the effects of burning and takes no damage from fire- or heat-based attacks.

name: Fluid Liquid
marques: takes 6 more unsoakable damage per turn
takes 4 more unsoakable damage per turn
takes 2 more unsoakable damage per turn
takes no additional unsoakable damage per turn
text: The living liquid is exceptionally fluid, making it immune to normal attacks such as those from weapons, guns, and bows. The downside, though, is that it causes the liquid to evaporate more rapidly. Non-physical attacks such as those from fire, electricity, aether rays, et cetera all still damage the living liquid normally.

name: Gas Devourer
text:
Cost: 1 AP
The living liquid is able to absorb a gas that it is inside of, sucking it away. It costs the living liquid 1 action point to try to absorb the gas. When the living liquid attempts to absorb the gas, a roll must be made to see if the gas is dispersed, but the living liquid causes that roll to have a bonus.

name: Great Strength
text: The liquid has small hydraulic veins running through it, a small change that makes the living liquid almost absurdly stronger. It gains a bonus on all brute rolls.

name: Guiding Liquid
text:
For use with Living Ammunition.
The living liquid is designed to be used as living ammunition and it guides its way toward its target. It gains a bonus on the accuracy roll to hit its target when used as living ammunition.

name: Hearty Ooze
text: The living liquid is tough and almost rubbery, making it that much more resilient. The living liquid has more hit points.

name: Heating Grasp
marques: Tier 1 Burns (-1 on defense rolls), Tier 2 Brute to resist
Tier 2 Burns (-3 on defense rolls), Tier 2 Brute to resist
Tier 2 Burns (-3 on defense rolls), Tier 3 Brute to resist
Tier 3 Burns (-5 on defense rolls), Tier 3 Brute to resist
text:
Cost: 1 AP
The living liquid is able to super-heat its body, burning a person it is grabbing. It can turn on the heat for 1 action point, at which point the person it's holding can make a resist. The burns last until the target is able to take a breather.

name: Interior Platelets
text: The living liquid forms bone-like platelets inside of its body that protect it from powerful attack.

name: Lifting Liquid
marques: Can grab a target (friend or foe) and lift it into the air, moving at its lighter-than-air speed.
notes: always priced mQ II (25 princes to buy, 5 princes to craft)
text:
Requires: Lighter-than-Air Liquid augment
The liquid is made to be so light that it can grab a target (be it friendly or unfriendly) and lift them into the air. It moves using its lighter-than-air speed.
Note: When determining cost, this augment functions as a Marque II augment. Thus, it costs 25 princes to buy or 5 princes to craft.

name: Lighter-than-Air Liquid
marques: Can fly 5 feet per action point
Can fly 10 feet per action point
Can fly 15 feet per action point
Can fly 20 feet per action point
text: Living liquids with this augment become so light that they are able to fly. The living liquid gains a flight speed.

name: Limb Wrapper
marques: Can grab two called shot locations
Can grab three called shot locations
Can grab four called shot locations
Can grab five called shot locations
text: The living liquid is long, tough, and elastic. It can wrap around several limbs, allowing it to grab multiple called shot locations on the same target.

name: Loyally Defending
marques: Takes the hit meant for an adjacent ally (decide before evade is rolled; automatic).
notes: Cost: 1 AP reflexive (the liquid's); always priced mQ II (25 princes to buy, 5 princes to craft)
text:
Cost: 1 AP reflexively
The living liquid can jump up and take the hit an adjacent ally was supposed to take. It costs the living liquid 1 action point and the ally must be adjacent to the liquid, but the effect is automatic. The living liquid must decide to do this before evade is rolled, and the living liquid automatically takes the hit.
Note: When determining cost, this augment functions as a Marque II augment. Thus, it costs 25 princes to buy or 5 princes to craft.

name: Nimble
text: The living liquid has a visible nervous system inside of it that allows for better reactions and a much more precise control over its appendages. This gives the living liquid a bonus on all dexterity rolls.

name: Observing
text: The living liquid has a gelatinous brain inside of it that radically increases all of its senses. It gains a substantial bonus on all cunning rolls.

name: Petrifying Grasp
notes: Cost: 1 AP reflexive (the liquid's). mQ IV is +36 in the book (not +32).
text:
Cost: 1 AP reflexively
The living liquid is designed to latch onto opponents and never let them go. It can temporarily harden itself against being broken out of. Any time a grabbed opponent attempts to break free, the living liquid may spend 1 action point reflexively to gain a bonus against the resist.

name: Powerful
text: The living liquid is much more elastic and thus can slam into targets harder. The living liquid gains a strike bonus.

name: Rolling Dodger
text: The living liquid becomes incredibly active, dodging and flipping out of the way from oncoming attacks. The living liquid gains an evade bonus.

name: Seeping
text: The living liquid is able to seep into porous materials (such as spongy rock, dirt, sand, and tight areas). Once inside, it takes a speed penalty, but does gain any other bonuses to its ground movement. It cannot attack while seeping through porous materials, so it must come out into the open.

name: Slick
marques: Its speed increases by 10 feet per action point
Its speed increases by 20 feet per action point
Its speed increases by 30 feet per action point
Its speed increases by 40 feet per action point
text: The living liquid is very slick, allowing it to glide along the ground at incredible speeds. Its ground speed increases.

name: Slippery Spot
text: The living liquid is so slippery that anyone that enters the same space as it must succeed in a dexterity resist or fall prone.

name: Stable
marques: takes 1 less unsoakable damage per turn
takes 2 less unsoakable damage per turn
takes 3 less unsoakable damage per turn
takes 4 less unsoakable damage per turn
text: The living liquid forms a light skin around the water, slowing the evaporation process.

name: Sticky
marques: +3 on all grab rolls (accuracy and resists)
+6 on all grab rolls (accuracy and resists)
+9 on all grab rolls (accuracy and resists)
+12 on all grab rolls (accuracy and resists)
text: The living liquid consists of a super sticky material that lends itself to holding on to things and not letting go. It gains a bonus on all accuracy rolls made when grabbing, and it gains that same bonus against people resisting the grab. This also grants the living liquid the ability to move up walls effortlessly.

name: Walking Weapon
text: The living liquid forms melee weapons from its body when attacking. These weapons range from spikes to sharp fangs to actual weapons.

name: Whiplash
marques: +2 on accuracy and strike rolls when whiplashing
+4 on accuracy and strike rolls when whiplashing
+6 on accuracy and strike rolls when whiplashing
+8 on accuracy and strike rolls when whiplashing
text:
Cost: 1 AP reflexively
The living liquid lashes back when struck in melee. If attacked, the living liquid can immediately retaliate with an attack of its own and gains a bonus on the accuracy and strike rolls.
